eval: (() => { const th = document.querySelectorAll('.thumb'); const spacer = document.querySelector('.list').firstElementChild; window.__dt = new DataTransfer(); th[2].dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragstart', { bubbles: true, dataTransfer: window.__dt })); const a = th[0].getBoundingClientRect(); const b = th[1].getBoundingClientRect(); window.__drop = { x: a.left + 10, y: (a.bottom + b.top) / 2 }; window.__gap = [a.bottom, b.top]; spacer.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragover', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: window.__dt, clientX: window.__drop.x, clientY: window.__drop.y })); return true; })()

assert: (() => { const ind = document.querySelector('.drop-indicator'); if (!ind) return 'ERREUR pas d indicateur'; const t = ind.getBoundingClientRect().top; const th = document.querySelectorAll('.thumb'); const second = th[1].getBoundingClientRect(); const third = th[2].getBoundingClientRect(); return (t > second.top - 60 && t < second.top + 10 && t < third.top) || 'ERREUR ' + t + ' (vignette 2 en ' + second.top + ')'; })()
